import json,collections
x=[json.loads(s) for s in open('items.jsonl')];r=[json.loads(s) for s in open('answers.jsonl')]
for n in [14,19,49,52,64]:
 r[n-1]['answer']=next(k for k,v in x[n-1]['options'].items() if v=='baseline dot')
for n in [7,17,25,29,49,52,57,61,64,82,84]:
 r[n-1]['confidence']='low';r[n-1]['note']='Dot is low within the digit height; vertical classification is borderline.'
open('answers.jsonl','w').write(''.join(json.dumps(t)+'\n' for t in r))
assert len(r)==len(x)
assert len({t['item_id'] for t in r})==len(r)
for t,a in zip(x,r):
 assert t['item_id']==a['item_id']
 assert a['answer'] in t['options']
 assert a['confidence'] in ['high','low']
assert len(open('answers.jsonl').readlines())==len(x)
print('Validated count, order, and option letters:',len(r))
print(dict(collections.Counter(t['options'][a['answer']] for t,a in zip(x,r))))
print('Low confidence:',sum(t['confidence']=='low' for t in r))
